description: This file defines the class DataElementFile, which is a specialized data element representing a file within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes methods for managing file operations such as loading, unloading, unlinking, destroying, and memory mapping, and references other core components like DataElement, FileSystem, and Portability.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: A class representing a file data element with capabilities for file management, including loading, unloading, unlinking, destroying, and memory mapping, within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the file.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file is currently open and valid.

methods.name: Storage
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying File object.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code from file operations.

methods.name: ReloadFileInfo
methods.description: Reloads the file information from the filesystem.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with a username.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with a group name.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Returns permission bits for a given mode.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Unlinks (deletes) the file from the filesystem.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the file, possibly removing it permanently.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the file content or metadata.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the file state with the storage.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Handles reallocation of the file's memory mapping.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens or creates a memory-mapped file with a specified size.
